audit_rows.fitted_B_separation: the two fitted B values of THIS stage (360 and 476.37) differ by the same 32.3% — both are recorded diagnostics, carried separately to S6

gf02_gf04_audit.classification: GF-02's plateau sits at exactly 4/5 of the 450 physical per-direction aggregate (the CAL-A12 derating factor, the first measured point ON that bridge); GF-04's 476.37 sits 5.86% ABOVE 450 — no physical B <= 450 can produce it under the single-port injection abstraction, and in-network computing is declared unsupported by every L0 backend: the 476.37 figure is the NVLS/in-switch-reduction algorithm class (stage GF-02's classification, inherited). The 32.3% span between two same-fabric community/vendor readings is therefore a SOFTWARE-STACK/ALGORITHM axis (NCCL algorithm choice unpinned in both threads), not a fabric axis — B in this family is a software-effective rate, and the discrepancy is exactly the range of that effectiveness. KEPT OPEN: the two numbers are never averaged or reconciled into one parameter; both fitted values stand as separate diagnostics with their own provenance
gf02_gf04_audit.duty: the split record assigns this group the open 360 (GF-02) vs 476.37 (GF-04) GB/s discrepancy audit — carried, classified, never averaged
gf02_gf04_audit.implication_for_the_fit_family: any single-B claim about the 8xH100 NVSwitch class must carry a software-config pin or a >= 32% algorithm-class bracket; the L0 input space has no algorithm-class parameter (structural, recorded — the same blindness class as the CAL-A6 version axis and the size-dependent ramp of S2)

headline: group G2 fits: CAL-A6 two-point minimax per NCCL version lands at B_fit = 388.7275 (2.19.3, worst ±0.62%) and 374.5143 B/ns (2.20.3, worst ±2.19%) — a -3.66% fitted-B separation that IS the anchor's noise-floor role executed on the parameter axis; GF-02 is degenerate (B_fit = 360 exactly, residuals = the pure latency terms, worst +0.061% at the band bottom); GF-04 is degenerate (B_fit = 476.37 exactly, fit-point residual +0.018%) with the 16-GPU point held out: the model at the fitted B misses it by -1.37% (rank-count-invariance vs the measured -1.41% busbw drop — the fabric-asymmetry known-omission finding); the 360-vs-476.37 audit resolves to a 32.3% software-stack/algorithm axis on the same fabric class — kept open, both fitted values carried as separate diagnostics

held_out_evaluation.finding: the held-out deviation is -1.37% (the model at the fitted B runs 1.37% FASTER than the measured 16-GPU leg): the single-B identity is rank-count-invariant in busbw by construction (model ratio 1 - 1.8e-4) while the anchor measures a -1.41% drop — the 8->16 crossing cost (an inter-node RoCE leg distinct from the intra-node fabric) is structurally inexpressible in the uniform-B input space. THE MISS IS THE FINDING (known-omission candidate: fabric asymmetry / r-dependent effective bandwidth); nothing was tuned toward this point — B_fit was fixed by the 8-GPU leg alone before this evaluation existed

A B quoted for this regime without an NCCL pin is software-state-dependent to at least this degree — recorded, never tuned
